# ngx-runtime-i18n

> Signals-first runtime internationalization for Angular 16 through 22. Catalogs load at runtime instead of compiling into the bundle, missing keys resolve through a configurable fallback chain, and SSR seeds Angular's TransferState so the first client render matches the server-rendered markup.

`ngx-runtime-i18n` is a family of six npm packages, all published at version 2.1.0: a framework-agnostic formatter (`@ngx-runtime-i18n/core`), an Angular wrapper (`@ngx-runtime-i18n/angular`), optional PrimeNG and Angular Material adapters, an `ng add` schematic, and a CLI for extracting and validating translation keys. The Angular wrapper exposes a signals-first API (`I18nService.lang()`, `ready()`, `t()`, `t$()`) plus an RxJS-compatible `I18nCompatService` for codebases not yet on signals.

## Install

Core and Angular integration (required for any Angular app):

```bash
npm i @ngx-runtime-i18n/angular @ngx-runtime-i18n/core
```

Optional adapters and tooling:

```bash
npm i @ngx-runtime-i18n/primeng      # keeps PrimeNG's translation config in sync with I18nService.lang() (PrimeNG 17-21)
npm i @ngx-runtime-i18n/material     # keeps Material's paginator/sort/stepper Intl services in sync
ng add @ngx-runtime-i18n/schematics  # scaffolds provideRuntimeI18n() and sample catalogs into a workspace
npm i -D @ngx-runtime-i18n/cli       # ngx-i18n extract/check for catalog validation in CI
```

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://i18n.ashwinsathian.com/docs) — getting started, core concepts (fallback chains, catalog caching, ICU-lite formatting, type safety, SSR and hydration), and per-package reference.
- [Recipes](https://i18n.ashwinsathian.com/recipes) — worked examples: SSR with Express, route-scoped catalogs, preloading and caching, type-safe catalogs, the Material and PrimeNG adapters, the `ng-add` schematic, migrating from `ngx-translate`, and CI catalog validation.
- [Framework comparison](https://i18n.ashwinsathian.com/compare)
- [Changelog](https://i18n.ashwinsathian.com/changelog)
